text:
Type: rectangular overlay wall mirror
Use: decorating a wall, reflecting light; living room, dining room, bedroom, above a sideboard or fireplace
Style: traditional, glam, classic
Materials: champagne gold painted frame and fretwork overlay, mirror glass
Colors: champagne gold, pale warm beige
Shape: large rectangle with a raised oval and stepped Greek-key-like fretwork overlay over the glass, flat profile, substantial size
Feel: elegant, refined, light
Goes with: cream or soft grey walls, crystal, upholstered furniture; traditional or glam rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Wall Decor Mirror, 30" x 40", Champagne Gold
product.description: This mirror is an eye-catching and functional piece of art that hangs vertically or horizontally to accent entryways and transitional areas. The intersecting designs create a frame to add a subtle design statement. 30" x 40"; hangs vertically (40"H) or horizontally (30"H) Modern design with touch of metallic glam Mirrored glass with pale gold framing design Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware not included.
